title: Dust in the Wind

sections.name: Intro

sources.label: Heartwood Guitar, Kansas – Dust in the Wind (intro, one chord per four-beat bar, with shapes)

notes: Intro only. The first eight bars also match Pimapeggio's progression.

picking.description: A Travis-style picking pattern with the thumb on the bass and fingers on the off-beats, over C- and Am-shape chords. Verify by ear which strings the thumb alternates between.
